Wear safety helmets, shoes, gloves, etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing delivery valve.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.

Cleaning fluid,
 Filler. Rags.

Vibrometer,
 Dial indicator.

Measure vibrations level for bearing and compare it with the 
 setting value.

Check discharge, pressure and record their values in the table 
 and compare these values with the setting values.
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Disconnect pump motor.
Unbolt and lift off motor.
Disconnect piping connecting to turbine.
Loosen bolts connecting the pump to the oil tank.

Remove complete pump from oil tank. Transfer pump to workshop 
 for disassembly.
Remove coupling guard and pull off pump half coupling.
Remove lube oil pipe connecting to antifriction bearing.
Measure the clearances of the pump.

Loosen hexagon nuts and remove suction cover with wearing 
 ring.
Loosen impeller nut and remove lock washer.
Remove impeller from shaft and remove the key.

Loosen bolts at discharge elbow and nuts at suspension tube 
 and then remove volute casing from shaft.

Remove locking ring and force out shaft with ball bearing from 
 bearing skirt.
Loosen nut and pull off ball bearing.

sections.text:
It may be difficult to remove the individual components of the pump rotor 
[impeller, nuts or bearings] from the shaft. Never use impact methods such as 
hammer, etc

First use penetrating oil and 
pullers. If it is not successful, the respective parts should be slightly heated 
and then pulled off or pressed off, making sure that the shaft remains at the 
lowest possible temperature. After disassembly of the rotor elements by the 
application of heat, the shaft must be checked for run out.

items:
Measure impeller, wearing rings clearance. The clearance must 
 be within the limit [0.3 0.8].

Measure bearing bush and pump shaft clearance. The clearance 
 must be within the limit [0.08 0.146].

Examine impeller neck [suction and discharge sides] as well as 
 wearing rings and bearing bush for signs of radial rubbing. If rubbing is 
 detected, it may be remedied by remachining.

Make sure that the resulting clearances are not exceeding the 
 max. Permissible values.

Install new parts and restore the original clearances, if 
 larger

Examine the 
 shaft for rubbing marks at the bearing bush

Grind the shaft 
 if there is rubbing or minor damage

Make sure that 
 the clearances are not exceeding the permissible values, unless we must 
 replace the shaft.

Balance the pump 
 dynamically, if a new shaft is installed or one of impeller parts is replaced.

If the 
 removed bearings are good, we must wash them by oil, grease them, dry them and 
 install them in the pump again.

Use new 
 bearing, if minor discolorations or minor damage are detected

Insert key and 
 slide impeller over the shaft as far back on the shaft as it will go.

Install 
 lockwasher and secure in position on shaft by means of impeller nut.

Prior to dynamic 
 balancing, check pump rotor for run out at the impeller and the bearings [Max, 
 permissible run out 0.03].

Rebalance rotor 
 at max. Operating speed.

Coat the shaft with a lubricant after installing the rotor 
 elements on the shaft.

Insert bearing bush into volute casing and lock against 
 turning by means of a straight pin.

Install wearing ring in volute casing and lock against turning 
 by means of a grub screw.
Slide shaft through the bearing bush in the volute casing.

Insert key in the shaft and slide impeller into position. 
 Install lockwasher and secure in position by means of impeller nut.

Insert wearing ring in suction cover and lock it by the screw. 
 Install suction cover in volute casing and tighten bolts.

Insert pump unit with shaft into suspension tube. Bolt volute 
 casing to suspension tube.

Slide spacer ring over shaft collar and install ball bearing. 
 Insert locking ring and lock bearing in position with grooved nut.
Mount flexible coupling.
Reconnect lube oil pump.
Bolt discharge elbow to volute casing.
Check the alignment of the pump rotor after assembly.
Lock all bolts and nuts carefully.

Clean pump and motor shaft ends and coupling. Install key in 
 shaft keyway. Remove inserts from coupling. Heat hub and then mount it on the 
 shaft end.
Examine and install flexible inserts.

Put complete pump in oil tank and tighten bolts, mount on 
 drive motor, and connect piping.
Check the alignment of pump motor.

Reconnect mean power, check pump for correct direction of 
 rotation.

Exchange main power leads if opposite direction of rotation is 
 required.

Vent equipment, and then the pump is ready to be placed into 
 service.

Measure the pressure, discharge and vibration and compare them 
 with the setting values.

Technical specifications

Inspection Components
Rotating Components
